results.content:
## Extremely Disappointing – Costly Errors, No Accountability
I had a very frustrating experience with RunwayML and would strongly caution others before using their platform.  
  
The service consistently failed to deliver what it promises. While it gives the impression that the next generation will improve results, in reality it repeatedly produces incorrect outputs—costing you more credits each time.  
  
In my case, I clearly specified that the project was for Instagram Reels (9:16 format). Despite this, the system generated all videos in 16:9 landscape. This fundamental error forced me to regenerate everything at my own cost. The AI agent even acknowledged the mistake.  
  
The issues didn’t stop there:  
  
Incorrect images were generated multiple times despite clear instructions [...] Looking at 179 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. People frequently complain that the application produces poor quality outputs and burns through available credits way too fast. Customers also state that the monthly subscription pricing is exceptionally expensive and feels completely unfair. Users experienced endless processing queues and frequent technical errors t hat made finishing video projects nearly impossible. Consumer feedback shows deep frustration regarding sudden changes to paid access and unexpected limitations. Some reviewers were happy with the creative tools and workflow options provided by the system. They found the platform useful for their ongoing production tasks despite the overall negative consensus.See more [...] My final experience with customer support was particularly frustrating. I spent more than two hours working with the help desk trying to add a voice to a video. Throughout the conversation, I repeatedly explained that I did not want instructions on how to edit the video myself. I wanted the AI to regenerate the scene correctly. Instead, support continued to walk me through the editing steps. Some of the instructions were incomplete or incorrect, and there was no clear step-by-step guidance. Rather than resolving the underlying generation issue, the conversation focused on workarounds that did not address the problem.

results.title: Runway is rated "Bad" with 1.3 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Evaluating 64 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. Consumers encountered severe frustrations with the digital product, explaining that the software repeatedly failed to follow straightforward prompts, resulting in distorted or completely unusable video outputs. Customers frequently complained about the expensive subscription model and stated that customer support cons istently denied refund requests even when credits were wasted on endless mistakes. Some reviewers were happy with the visual quality and noted that initial creations or successful generations could sometimes look impressive despite the general inconsistency. A few individuals also mentioned receiving prompt assistance or refunds when dealing with specific account or billing issues.See more [...] I don't expect every AI generation to be perfect. AI makes mistakes. But if a service knows its technology is experimental and sometimes fails badly, I don't believe the customer should automatically bear the entire financial cost every single time.  
I have now cancelled my Pro subscription, said goodbye politely and uninstalled Runway. I even left a handful of unused credits behind because I simply didn't want to use the platform anymore.  
For me, Runway has been the worst AI platform I have used. Expensive, inconsistent, frustrating and an extremely poor experience.  
Runway may have impressive technology behind it, but until customers are treated more fairly when generations fail, I won't be coming back. [...] My final experience summed it up perfectly. I requested a South African dance video. What did I receive? A man repeatedly kicking dirt into the air. That was essentially the video. It wasn't remotely what I wanted, yet my credits were still taken.  
When I complained about credits being consumed on failed generations, I was told they couldn't be returned.  
After enough experiences like this, using Runway stopped being enjoyable and became genuinely stressful. The repeated loss of credits and feeling that I had no control over what I was being charged for caused me severe anxiety and made me physically feel sick. An AI creative platform should be enjoyable to use. It should not leave a paying customer feeling like that.
